title: Grasslands
source: After the notes' South America and Africa physical maps, with standard UPSC facts added

places.name: Llanos
places.significance: The tropical grassland of the Orinoco basin, flooded in the wet season and parched in the dry
notes: Tropical grassland — between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn
In Venezuela (and Colombia), along the **Orinoco** river

places.name: Catingas
places.significance: The thorny scrub of Brazil's drought-prone north-east, the land of the sertão
notes: Tropical grassland — between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn
In north-east Brazil — the northernmost of Brazil's three Cs

places.name: Cerrados
places.significance: Brazil's vast savanna of the central plateau around Brasília, now its soybean frontier
notes: Tropical grassland — between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn
In central Brazil — the middle of Brazil's three Cs

places.name: Campos
places.significance: Brazil's open highland grassland of the sertão, south of the north-east's thorn scrub
notes: Tropical grassland — between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn
In Brazil — the third of Brazil's three Cs

places.name: Gran Chaco
places.significance: The hot lowland plain of thorn forest and grass where Bolivia, Paraguay and Argentina meet, on the Tropic of Capricorn
notes: Spread over Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay and Argentina
On the Tropic of Capricorn

places.name: Pampas
places.significance: Argentina's flat, fertile temperate grassland round Buenos Aires, its cattle fed on alfalfa
notes: Temperate grassland — outside the Tropics
In Argentina
Alfalfa (lucerne) grass, grown to feed cattle

places.name: Savanna
places.significance: Africa's tropical grassland of tall grass and scattered trees, between the rainforest and the deserts, wet in summer and dry in winter
notes: Tropical grassland
**Elephant grass**: tall, coarse grass up to 3–4 m
The Sudan type climate — hot all year, rain in summer
Drawn where Köppen classes the climate tropical savanna (Aw)

places.name: Velds
places.significance: South Africa's temperate grassland on the high interior plateau, some 1,500–2,100 m up
notes: Temperate grasslands
In South Africa
The Highveld: the interior plateau between about 1,500 and 2,100 m

groups.name: Brazil's three Cs
groups.mnemonic: C1, C2, C3 — Catingas, Cerrados, Campos, north to south
